excerpt: A factor analysis on the belief items revealed a single Non-physicalist Beliefs factor with good internal consistency (Cronbach’s alpha = 0.86). Positive loadings included separate and supernatural realms, a non-natural unifying principle, panpsychism, dualism, and solipsism/idealism; negative loadings included hard materialism, physicalism, and naturalism.
overview: This factor-analysis result defines the main outcome variable used throughout the study. It matters because the reported belief changes are not tied to a single questionnaire item, but to a composite that contrasts non-physicalist positions with hard materialist or naturalist positions. The interpretation remains bounded by the authors’ warning that philosophical labels for items are contestable.
title: Non-Physicalist Factor Structure
